source.title: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future

items.name: Cold Adaptation
items.text: The young arabuk reduces the effects it suffers from cold environments by one step.

items.name: Snow Vision
items.text: Snow doesn't impair an arabuk's vision; it ignores Concealment from snowfall.

items.name: Pounce
items.text: The young arabuk Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the arabuk began this action Hidden, it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.

items.name: Snow Stride
items.text: The young arabuk ignores difficult terrain, greater difficult terrain, and uneven ground from non-magical ice and snow.
